title: Jameda Reviews Scraper
description: Extract public Jameda doctor reviews for one or more doctor profile URLs.

doctor_urls.title: Doctor URLs
doctor_urls.description: Recommended. Process many Jameda doctor profile URLs in one Apify run. Each saved review is one dataset item.

doctor_url.title: Legacy Doctor URL
doctor_url.description: Backward-compatible single Jameda doctor profile URL or path. Prefer Doctor URLs for normal usage, especially when monitoring reviews for more than one provider.

page.title: Page
page.description: One-based reviews page to fetch for each doctor URL.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order applied to available reviews.

rating.title: Rating Filter
rating.description: Optional rating filter. Use a single value from 1 to 5 or comma-separated values such as 4,5.

per_page.title: Reviews Per Page
per_page.description: Number of reviews to request per doctor URL.
